notes: The selected analysis panel is one selection for one study design. General availability per TCGA project is reported separately and is larger; do not mix the two.
Spatial studies come from patients other than those in TCGA. They add tissue context, not measurements for TCGA patients.

Spatial resources are shown at two image levels. "Original H&E located": the original scan, measured expression and coordinates were found. "Matched data with preview image": expression and coordinates match a released preview image, and the original scan was not located; such data support molecular spatial maps, not whole-slide or tile models, cell morphology, physical distances or registration sign-off. Registration, calibration and tissue QC may be pending at either level.

Spatial section records are per study, not globally unique physical sections or independent assays. Patients are study-local IDs given by the source; sections without one add no patients, and no eligible-patient total is established.
Counts reported by a study keep that study's own unit (sections, slides, samples, donors) and are never added across studies. An unknown count is absent, not zero.
located_sections lists selection fields only; the full record with links, source wording and clinical fields is in data/captures.json under the same id.

gaps: Publication-first histology gives 146 pheochromocytomas and 32 paragangliomas; five patients absent from the TCGA PCPG table use the GDC label. Two cases labelled pheochromocytoma in GDC are extra-adrenal paragangliomas in the publication table.

Two paragangliomas of the head and neck are confirmed by their pathology reports and retained; whether they are sympathetic or parasympathetic is not established. A sensitivity subset without them has 176 patients, all with both assays.
Historical benign and malignant morphology codes do not determine eligibility.
Cases with adrenal-cortical admixture are annotated, not removed as adrenocortical carcinoma; tissue composition and identity need their own checks.
Only three patients contribute normal-reference tissue.
PCPG remains a spatial access gap: two manuscript or preprint leads are listed, but no reusable measured spatial-RNA package with original H&E was verified.

other_resources.description: Pheochromocytoma and paraganglioma. Slide images, RNA-seq and Illumina 450k methylation from the same patients, with solid normal tissue from some patients. Analysed as one pooled cohort with location, publication-first histology, molecular subtype and adrenal-cortical admixture annotations. Counts are shown after PanCanAtlas assay exclusions, after a patient-level treatment and diagnosis screen, and for the selected analysis set. Tumour slide linkage and image QC have not yet been checked.
notes: Pooled PCPG (178 patients, all with both assays): 146 pheochromocytomas and 32 paragangliomas. Two pathology-confirmed head and neck paragangliomas are retained; a sensitivity subset without them has 176 patients.
Historical benign and malignant codes do not determine eligibility.
Normal tissue comes from patients with cancer, usually adjacent to the tumour. It is not a healthy-donor control.
